description: Use when an agent must know what an issuer can do to holders of an ERC-20 (stablecoin, RWA, ERC-3643) on Ethereum or Base. Input: address, optional chain (ethereum default, base), holder. Output: JSON capabilities (mint, burn from holder, pause, freeze/blacklist, seize, upgrade, ERC-3643), matched functions, proxy implementation, role holders, paused now, holder frozen status and balance. Example: ?address=0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48 Price: $0.003 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

holder.description: Also check this holder's blacklist / frozen status and balance

name: token_controls
title: Token issuer controls: mint, pause, freeze/blacklist, seize, upgrade, roles and a holder's frozen status
